failureReason: The model attempted multiple implementations across 4 runs but failed to correctly implement partial prefetching. The code never enabled partialPrefetching in next.config.ts, lacked "use cache" directives for caching category data, and relied on client-side prefetching patterns rather than server-side RSC prefetch with Link prefetch={true}. All runs failed tests for enabling partial prefetching, caching data, and prefetching category content before navigation.
